_comment: ClearPlan options. All file-system paths are stored in settings.ini.

constraintSource._comment: Automatic uses RefDB first and falls back visibly to Excel.

links._comment: Optional web links opened from the Help menu. Leave blank to show the local markdown file instead.

checks._comment: The starter profile keeps only general example checks in ErrorCalculator.

privacy._comment: Starter defaults avoid direct patient and user identifiers in logs and generated filenames. Set a site-specific hashSalt for stable pseudonyms across workstations.
